summary: Customer is developing a hot polymer extrusion process incorporating an active pharmaceutical ingredient and wants to investigate whether an optical measurement can detect composition changes while the melt is being processed. They have offline assays, but the process interface is hot and may be exposed to material build up. They need an initial comparison plan and the questions required before choosing a probe.
